# Commands whose CANONICAL SPOKEN PHRASE is a single word (queue 93).
#
# Execution rule 1: a one-word command never executes -- a single word is the
# user's text, not a trigger. Every id here is reachable only through a
# two-or-more-word alias, or through the configured command prefix
# (intent.command_prefix), and each one wants a two-word canonical form.
#
# Frozen so that ADDING a one-word command is a deliberate act with a test to
# change, not something that lands quietly. Generated by the assertion in
# tests/test_command_canonical.py; the proposed two-word forms live in the
# queue 93 report, not here -- this file is the gate, not the plan.
#
# snippets.insert (queue 121) is here on purpose: the command IS "insert
# <name>", whose canonical spoken phrase is one word. It carries the
# two-word alias "insert snippet" so there is an executable form, and the
# name it takes is a DECLARED required argument, so Ava can call it.
